fields.label: Baud Rate
fields.help: Speed of the default serial port, the one the USB cable lands on. Always active: the debugger answers here whether or not Modbus is enabled, and Modbus RTU shares it when it runs on this port.

fields.label: Use RS485 EN Pin
fields.help: Turn on when the board drives an external RS485 transceiver through an explicit driver-enable pin.

fields.label: RS485 EN Pin
fields.help: GPIO that drives DE/RE on the RS485 transceiver.
